Acbric quick start - 0.3.8

1. Fully extract the package and open Acbric.exe. Keep it with the rest of the folder.
   The default release includes its Java 21 runtime; no separate Java installation is needed.
2. On first use, confirm the Steam game found automatically and select "Use this game", or choose its folder manually.
3. Select "Start game". Use the same EXE next time.
4. For Steamworks and Workshop, select "Steam launch (owned copy)". The game must be installed in Steam, and the signed-in account must own App 342560. Subscribed Workshop content may synchronize before the menu opens.
5. Java MODs: place .jar files in the "mods" folder beside Acbric.exe.
   Native MODs: place folders directly containing info.json in the active data environment's "mods". In shared mode this is the original game data folder; with environment isolation it is Acbric's "mods".
   The API is included. Do not add another copy. Restart after changing Java MODs.
6. On the home screen, use "Sync now" to use the original saves and MODs directly. No files are copied.
   Use Settings -> Environment isolation if this instance needs separate copies.

Settings can change the game location, install a trusted local update ZIP or restore the previous framework. Close the game first, and do not extract an update over the old folder.

Help -> Export diagnostics creates a ZIP for the developer. It does not include saves and is never uploaded automatically.

First upgrade from dev.32 or earlier: extract the new package elsewhere, run its advanced/Update Acbric.cmd and select the original Acbric folder and new ZIP. Later updates use the EXE.

Default instance data: instances/default
Full guide: docs/INSTALLER.md
Chinese quick start: 使用说明.txt
